Body.Content:
Business Performance Planning introduce Virtualization to optimizes how the Matrix visual renders large planning datasets. Rather than loading and displaying the entire dataset at once, the visual progressively renders the rows and columns needed as users scroll, expand, collapse, and navigate through the Matrix. This reduces the amount of data processed by the browser at any one time and helps maintain visual responsiveness at scale.

GA date: October CY2026
